svg.text: SiteStar data hall - board 1: ESP32 sensors + safety (top) · board 2: UNO R4 operator console (bottom)
Every coloured line is one jumper wire. Gold dots are pins. Rails: red = 5V, orange = 3.3V, black = GND.
SMOKE receiver · LDR to 3V3 · 10k to GND
valve arm presses it when SHUT
people in the data hall · middle pin = OUT
red → ESP32 VIN · brown GND · orange SIG
220Ω on each colour · longest leg = GND
VIN = USB 5V for the servo, PIR and fan. Never join the battery 5V rail to VIN. Leak sensor dry + beam clear at power-up.
Board 2: operator console - UNO R4 WiFi + 4-digit display + keypad. Its own USB cable. NOT wired to the ESP32 or the rails.
dots at the BOTTOM · pin 1 = bottom-left
ribbon at the bottom · pins left → right
A = grid event · B = end · 40# = cut 40%
